prompt.content:
Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: Which of the following best conserves natural resources that are used to make a television?
A. repair your broken television
B. buy a television that is on sale
C. throw old televisions in the trash
D. donate a new television to your school
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
